source.text: ἐγὼ περὶ αὐτῶν ἐρωτῶ· οὐ περὶ τοῦ κόσμου ἐρωτῶ ἀλλὰ περὶ ὧν δέδωκάς μοι, ὅτι σοί εἰσιν, καὶ τὰ ἐμὰ πάντα σά ἐστιν καὶ τὰ σὰ ἐμά, καὶ δεδόξασμαι ἐν αὐτοῖς.

records.literal_gloss: I concerning them ask; not concerning the world I ask but concerning [those] whom you have given me, because yours they are, \v 10 and the mine all yours is and the yours mine, and I have been glorified in them.

en.L: I am asking concerning them; I am not asking concerning the world, but concerning those whom {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have given {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, because they are {{deity_pronoun:yours|Yours}}, \v 10 and all things that are {{deity_pronoun:mine|Mine}} are {{deity_pronoun:yours|Yours}}, and {{deity_pronoun:yours|Yours}} [are] {{deity_pronoun:mine|Mine}}, and I have been glorified in them.
en.B: I am asking on their behalf. I am not asking on the world's behalf, but on behalf of those whom {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have given {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, because they belong to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. \v 10 All that is {{deity_pronoun:mine|Mine}} is {{deity_pronoun:yours|Yours}}, and all that is {{deity_pronoun:yours|Yours}} is {{deity_pronoun:mine|Mine}}, and I have been glorified in them.
en.R: I am praying for them. I am not praying for the world, but for the people {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have given {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, because they belong to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. \v 10 Everything that is {{deity_pronoun:mine|Mine}} is {{deity_pronoun:yours|Yours}}, and everything that is {{deity_pronoun:yours|Yours}} is {{deity_pronoun:mine|Mine}}. And {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} glory has been shown in them.

fr.L: Moi, je prie à leur sujet ; je ne prie pas au sujet du monde, mais au sujet de ceux que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}as donnés, parce qu’ils sont à {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, \v 10 et tout ce qui est {{deity_pronoun:mien|Mien}} est {{deity_pronoun:tien|Tien}}, et ce qui est {{deity_pronoun:tien|Tien}} [est] {{deity_pronoun:mien|Mien}}, et j’ai été glorifié en eux.
fr.B: Je prie pour eux. Je ne prie pas pour le monde, mais pour ceux que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}as donnés, parce qu’ils {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}appartiennent. \v 10 Tout ce qui {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}appartient {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}appartient, et tout ce qui {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}appartient {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}appartient, et j’ai été glorifié en eux.
fr.R: Je prie pour eux. Je ne prie pas pour le monde, mais pour ceux que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}as donnés, parce qu’ils sont à {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. \v 10 Tout ce qui est à {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} est à {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, et tout ce qui est à {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} est à {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. Et {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} gloire se voit en eux.

sw.L: Mimi ninaomba kwa ajili yao; siombi kwa ajili ya ulimwengu, bali kwa ajili ya wale ulionipa, kwa sababu ni {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, \v 10 na vyote vilivyo {{deity_pronoun:vyangu|Vyangu}} ni {{deity_pronoun:vyako|Vyako}}, na vilivyo {{deity_pronoun:vyako|Vyako}} [ni] {{deity_pronoun:vyangu|Vyangu}}, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nimetukuzwa ndani yao.
sw.B: Ninawaombea wao. Siuombei ulimwengu, bali ninawaombea wale ulionipa, kwa sababu ni {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}. \v 10 Vyote vilivyo {{deity_pronoun:vyangu|Vyangu}} ni {{deity_pronoun:vyako|Vyako}}, na vyote vilivyo {{deity_pronoun:vyako|Vyako}} ni {{deity_pronoun:vyangu|Vyangu}}, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nimetukuzwa ndani yao.
sw.R: Ninawaombea wao. Siuombei ulimwengu, bali ninawaombea watu ulionipa, kwa sababu ni {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}. \v 10 Kila kitu kilicho {{deity_pronoun:changu|Changu}} ni {{deity_pronoun:chako|Chako}}, na kila kitu kilicho {{deity_pronoun:chako|Chako}} ni {{deity_pronoun:changu|Changu}}. Na utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} umeonekana ndani yao.

vi.L: Con cầu xin cho họ; Con không cầu xin cho thế gian, nhưng cho những người Cha đã ban cho Con, vì họ thuộc về Cha, \v 10 và mọi điều của Con đều là của Cha, và những gì của Cha [là] của Con, và Con đã được tôn vinh trong họ.
vi.B: Con cầu xin cho họ. Con không cầu xin cho thế gian, nhưng cho những người Cha đã ban cho Con, vì họ thuộc về Cha. \v 10 Mọi điều của Con đều là của Cha, và mọi điều của Cha cũng là của Con; và Con đã được tôn vinh nơi họ.
vi.R: Con cầu nguyện cho họ. Con không cầu nguyện cho thế gian, nhưng cho những người Cha đã ban cho Con, vì họ thuộc về Cha. \v 10 Mọi điều thuộc về Con đều thuộc về Cha, và mọi điều thuộc về Cha cũng thuộc về Con. Vinh quang của Con đã được bày tỏ nơi họ.

ko.L: 저는 그들을 위하여 청합니다. 세상을 위하여 청하는 것이 아니라, 아버지께서 저에게 주신 [이들을] 위하여 [청합니다]. 그들은 아버지의 것이기 때문입니다. \v 10 제 것은 모두 아버지의 것이고, 아버지의 것은 제 것입니다. 그리고 저는 그들 안에서 영광을 받았습니다.
ko.B: 저는 그들을 위하여 청합니다. 세상을 위해서가 아니라, 아버지께서 저에게 주신 사람들을 위하여 청합니다. 그들은 아버지께 속한 사람들이기 때문입니다. \v 10 제 것은 다 아버지의 것이고, 아버지의 것은 다 제 것입니다. 그리고 저는 그들 안에서 영광을 받았습니다.
ko.R: 저는 그들을 위해 기도합니다. 세상을 위해서가 아니라, 아버지께서 저에게 주신 사람들을 위해 기도합니다. 그들은 아버지의 사람들이기 때문입니다. \v 10 제 것은 모두 아버지의 것이고, 아버지의 것은 모두 제 것입니다. 그리고 그들을 통해 제 영광이 드러났습니다.

decisions.choice: I am asking: Jesus makes a request of the Father on behalf of the disciples
decisions.reason: The verb ἐρωτῶ can mean to ask a question or to make a request. In the farewell discourses John uses it for Jesus's requests to the Father (14:16; 16:26), and it runs through this prayer (17:15, 20). The pronoun "I" is stated, which gives weight to it: Jesus himself intercedes for them.

decisions.choice: not for the world: in this part of the prayer Jesus prays for his disciples; it does not mean that the world is outside God's love
alternatives: Jesus refuses to pray for the world at all
decisions.reason: God loved the world and sent the Son to save it (3:16-17), and later in this same prayer Jesus asks that the world may believe and know that the Father sent him (17:21, 23). Here the request is narrower: it is for the people the Father has given him, who are about to be left in a hostile world (17:11, 14). The sentence says who this request is for, not who God cares about.

decisions.choice: all things that are mine are yours: a complete sharing of everything between the Son and the Father, of which the disciples are a part
alternatives: all the people who are mine are yours
decisions.reason: The words for "mine" and "yours" are neuter plural, "all things", not just "all the people". Jesus has said the same in 16:15 ("all that the Father has is mine"). The disciples are included in that sharing: they were the Father's, he gave them to the Son (17:6), and they remain the Father's.

decisions.choice: I have been glorified in them: Jesus's glory has already been shown in the disciples, who received his words and believed
alternatives: I will be glorified in them, spoken of the future as already done
decisions.reason: The verb δεδόξασμαι is perfect: something done that still stands. In 17:6-8 Jesus has said that the disciples kept the Father's word, received his words and believed that the Father sent him. Their faith shows who he is, and so he is glorified in them. The coming glory of the cross (17:1, 5) is still ahead, so some read the perfect as looking forward; the context points to what has already happened.

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}}, {{deity_pronoun:yours|Yours}}, {{deity_pronoun:yourself|Yourself}} for the Father; {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}}, {{deity_pronoun:mine|Mine}}, {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}} for Jesus; {{deity_pronoun:we|We}} for the Father and the Son
decisions.reason: The whole passage is Jesus's prayer to the Father. Every pronoun for the Father ("you", "your", "yours", "yourself") and every pronoun Jesus uses of himself except "I" takes the deity_pronoun setting, as does "we" for the Father and the Son together (as 14:23). At the start of a sentence the pronoun is written plain.

decisions.choice: asking (L, B); praying (R); my glory has been shown in them (R)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep "ask", so the repeated verb stays visible here and in 17:15 and 17:20. Readable says "praying", the everyday word for asking God for something (meaning decision m1). Readable turns the passive "I have been glorified in them" around so that it is easy to follow, and keeps "glory" (meaning decision m4).

decisions.choice: speech tenses: passé composé for the Greek aorist and perfect at every level ("j’ai été glorifié", "je les ai envoyés"), imperfect for what went on ("je les gardais", L), present for the present ("je prie")
alternatives: passé simple for the aorists at Literal
decisions.reason: The whole passage (17:9-19) is Jesus's prayer, so there is no narration; the French brief puts speech in the passé composé at every level, which serves both the Greek perfect and the aorist, as people speak to God.

decisions.choice: je prie (pour eux)
decisions.reason: The verb means making a request on someone's behalf (meaning decision m1). French "prier pour" says exactly that and is the plainest word for praying for someone; "demander" is kept for asking for something (verse 15).

decisions.choice: tout ce qui est {{deity_pronoun:mien|Mien}} est {{deity_pronoun:tien|Tien}} (L); à moi, à toi (R); m’appartient, t’appartient (B)
alternatives: tout ce qui est à moi est à toi (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek possessive adjectives with "mien" and "tien", which also take the deity_pronoun setting, as "mine" and "yours" do in English.

decisions.choice: spans on the free pronouns and possessives for the Father and the Son (wako, vyangu, vyako, nami, sisi, kwako, lako)
decisions.reason: As in 17:1: in this prayer the Father is addressed with "wewe", and only free pronouns and possessives carry the reader setting, since Swahili marks most pronouns inside the verb. One at the start of a sentence is written plain. This holds for verses 9-19.

decisions.choice: kuomba kwa ajili ya (L), kuombea (B, R); vyote vilivyo vyangu (things)
decisions.reason: Swahili "kuomba" is both asking for something and praying, so every level keeps one verb here and in verses 15 and 20 (meaning note m1); Literal says "ninaomba kwa ajili yao" for "concerning them". "Mine" and "yours" are neuter plural, all things (m3), so Swahili uses the class of things ("vyote vilivyo vyangu"), not of people.

decisions.choice: "Cha" for the Father and "Con" for Jesus, with no setting spans, through the prayer
decisions.reason: As the style guide sets for John 17, recorded once in this passage: Jesus speaks to the Father as a son, saying "Cha" for "you" and "Con" for "I" and "me". Both are capitalised nouns and take no deity_pronoun setting.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in Korean
alternatives: capitalised pronoun spans as in English
decisions.reason: Korean has no capital letters, so the deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change; respect is carried by the honorific -si-, 께서 and 그분 at every level (style guide section 7).

decisions.choice: 청하다 (L, B); 기도하다 (R) for Jesus's asking
decisions.reason: 청하다 is a request made of a superior on someone's behalf, as in 16:26; Readable uses the everyday word for praying.

source.text: καὶ οὐκέτι εἰμὶ ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ, καὶ αὐτοὶ ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ εἰσίν, κἀγὼ πρὸς σὲ ἔρχομαι.

records.literal_gloss: And no longer I am in the world, and they in the world are, and I to you am coming.

en.L: And I am no longer in the world, and they are in the world, and I am coming to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.B: I am no longer in the world, but they are still in the world, and I am coming to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.R: Soon I will not be in the world any longer, but they will still be in the world. I am coming to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

fr.L: Et je ne suis plus dans le monde, et eux sont dans le monde, et {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, je viens vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
fr.B: Je ne suis plus dans le monde, mais eux sont encore dans le monde, et {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, je viens à {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
fr.R: Bientôt, je ne serai plus dans le monde, mais eux y seront encore. Moi, je viens auprès de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.

sw.L: Na siko tena ulimwenguni, nao wako ulimwenguni, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} ninakuja {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}}.
sw.B: Siko tena ulimwenguni, lakini wao bado wako ulimwenguni, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} ninakuja {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}}.
sw.R: Hivi karibuni sitakuwa tena ulimwenguni, lakini wao bado watakuwa ulimwenguni. Ninakuja {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}}.

vi.L: Và Con không còn ở trong thế gian nữa, còn họ ở trong thế gian, và Con đến cùng Cha.
vi.B: Con không còn ở trong thế gian nữa, nhưng họ vẫn còn ở trong thế gian, và Con đang đến cùng Cha.
vi.R: Con sắp không còn ở trong thế gian nữa, nhưng họ vẫn còn ở trong thế gian. Con đang về với Cha.

ko.L: 저는 더 이상 세상에 있지 않고, 그들은 세상에 있으며, 저는 아버지께로 갑니다.
ko.B: 저는 이제 더 이상 세상에 있지 않지만, 그들은 아직 세상에 있습니다. 그리고 저는 아버지께로 갑니다.
ko.R: 저는 곧 세상을 떠나지만, 그들은 아직 세상에 남아 있을 것입니다. 저는 아버지께로 갑니다.

decisions.choice: I am no longer in the world: Jesus speaks of his departure as though it has already happened
alternatives: Jesus has already left the world
decisions.reason: Jesus is still with the disciples and still speaking "in the world" (17:13), but his hour has come (17:1) and he is on his way to the Father (13:1; 16:28). The present tense looks at his going as settled. "I am coming to you" says the same thing from the other side.

decisions.choice: and they are in the world: a contrast; the disciples stay behind in the world that Jesus is leaving
decisions.reason: The pronoun αὐτοὶ ("they") is stated, setting the disciples against Jesus: he is going, they are staying. The world here is the world of people that hates them (17:14), which is why they need the Father's keeping in the next sentence.

decisions.choice: but ... still (B); Soon I will no longer be ... will still be (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "but" for the "and" of contrast and add "still" (meaning decision m2). Readable adds "Soon" and "any longer" and uses the future so that a young reader is not puzzled that Jesus, who is speaking, says he is no longer in the world (meaning decision m1).

source.text: πάτερ ἅγιε, τήρησον αὐτοὺς ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί σου ᾧ δέδωκάς μοι, ἵνα ὦσιν ἓν καθὼς ἡμεῖς.

records.literal_gloss: Father holy, keep them in the name of you which you have given me, so that they may be one just as we.

en.L: Holy Father, keep them in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name, which {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have given {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, so that they may be one just as {{deity_pronoun:we|We}} [are].
en.B: Holy Father, keep them in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name, the name {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have given {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, so that they may be one, just as {{deity_pronoun:we|We}} are one.
en.R: Holy Father, keep them safe by the power of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name, the name {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have given {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. Then they will be one, just as {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} and I are one.

fr.L: Père saint, garde-les en {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom, que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}as donné, afin qu’ils soient un comme {{deity_pronoun:nous|Nous}} [le sommes].
fr.B: Père saint, garde-les en {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom, le nom que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}as donné, pour qu’ils soient un, comme {{deity_pronoun:nous|Nous}} sommes un.
fr.R: Père saint, protège-les par la puissance de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom, le nom que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}as donné. Alors ils seront un, comme {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} et {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, {{deity_pronoun:nous|Nous}} sommes un.

sw.L: Baba Mtakatifu, uwatunze katika jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} ambalo umenipa, ili wawe kitu kimoja kama {{deity_pronoun:sisi|Sisi}} [tulivyo].
sw.B: Baba Mtakatifu, uwatunze katika jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}, lile jina ambalo umenipa, ili wawe wamoja, kama {{deity_pronoun:sisi|Sisi}} tulivyo wamoja.
sw.R: Baba Mtakatifu, uwalinde salama kwa nguvu ya jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}, lile jina ulilonipa. Ndipo watakuwa wamoja, kama {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} na {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} tulivyo wamoja.

vi.L: Lạy Cha thánh, xin gìn giữ họ trong danh Cha, [danh] mà Cha đã ban cho Con, để họ là một như chúng ta [là một].
vi.B: Lạy Cha thánh, xin gìn giữ họ trong danh Cha, là danh Cha đã ban cho Con, để họ được hiệp một như Cha và Con là một.
vi.R: Lạy Cha thánh, xin dùng quyền năng của danh Cha, là danh Cha đã ban cho Con, mà gìn giữ họ được an toàn. Như vậy họ sẽ hiệp một, như Cha và Con là một.

ko.L: 거룩하신 아버지, 아버지께서 저에게 주신 아버지의 이름 안에서 그들을 지키십시오. 이는 우리처럼 그들도 하나가 되게 하려는 것입니다.
ko.B: 거룩하신 아버지, 아버지께서 저에게 주신 그 이름으로 그들을 지켜 주셔서, 우리가 하나인 것처럼 그들도 하나가 되게 해 주십시오.
ko.R: 거룩하신 아버지, 아버지께서 저에게 주신 그 이름의 능력으로 그들을 지켜 주십시오. 그러면 아버지와 제가 하나인 것처럼 그들도 하나가 될 것입니다.

decisions.choice: which you have given me: the Father has given his name to the Son (ᾧ, agreeing with "name")
alternatives: whom you have given me: the Father has given the disciples to the Son (οὓς)
that which you have given me (a neuter relative)
decisions.reason: The SBLGNT reads ᾧ, the relative pronoun in the case of "name": the name is what the Father gave. This is the reading of most early manuscripts. Some manuscripts, mainly later ones and some of the Western tradition, read οὓς ("those whom"), making the disciples what was given, and a few have a neuter relative. Copyists were more likely to change the unusual idea of a name given to the Son into the familiar idea of disciples given to him (17:6, 9) than the reverse. The same variation appears in 17:12. A reviewer should check this against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: Holy Father: a unique address that stresses the Father's holiness, and ties this request to "sanctify" in 17:17 and 17:19
decisions.reason: Nowhere else in the New Testament is God addressed as "Holy Father"; later Jesus says "righteous Father" (17:25). ἅγιε ("holy") shares its root with the verb "sanctify" (make holy) in 17:17 and 17:19: the holy Father is asked to keep the disciples and to make them his own.

decisions.choice: keep them in your name: guard them by the power of the Father's name, as people who belong to it
alternatives: keep them faithful to your name
decisions.reason: In the Bible God's name stands for God himself as he has made himself known, with his power and authority (Psalm 20:2; Proverbs 18:10). Jesus has made that name known to the disciples (17:6). "In" carries both ideas: by the protecting power of the name, and within the circle of those who bear it. The name was given to the Son (compare Exodus 23:21, "my name is in him"; Philippians 2:9), so Jesus has been keeping them in it (17:12).

decisions.choice: so that they may be one just as we are: the unity of the disciples is modeled on the unity of the Father and the Son
decisions.reason: "We" is the Father and the Son, whose oneness Jesus has spoken of before (10:30). The disciples' unity is meant to reflect it, and the prayer returns to this at length in 17:21-23.

decisions.choice: just as {{deity_pronoun:we|We}} [are] (L); just as {{deity_pronoun:we|We}} are one (B); just as {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} and I are one (R)
decisions.reason: "We" means the Father and the Son, so it takes the deity_pronoun setting, as in 14:23. Readable names the two ("you and I"), which avoids an unclear "we"; "you" takes the setting and "I" does not. Balanced and Readable repeat "one" where the Greek leaves it understood.

decisions.choice: the name you have given me (B, R); keep them safe by the power of your name (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable repeat "the name" so that it is clear that the name is what was given (meaning decision m1). Readable spells out what "in your name" means (meaning decision m3) and starts a new sentence with "Then" for the purpose clause.

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:nous|Nous}} for the Father and the Son
decisions.reason: "We" here means the Father and the Son (meaning decision m4), so it takes the deity_pronoun setting as in English. Literal brackets "[le sommes]", which French needs after "comme nous".

decisions.choice: uwatunze (L, B), uwalinde salama (R); kitu kimoja (L), wamoja (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Kutunza" (keep, take care of) is used for this verb when its object is people, here and in verses 12 and 15 at Literal; Readable says "keep safe" as the English does. The neuter "one" is rendered as at 10:30: "kitu kimoja" at Literal, "wamoja" (united, at one) at Balanced and Readable. "Sisi" is the Father and the Son and carries the setting; Readable names them, "wewe na mimi", and both carry it.

decisions.choice: chúng ta (L); Cha và Con (B, R), with no setting span
decisions.reason: The English "we" carries the deity_pronoun setting. The style guide gives Vietnamese spans only for "ngài" and "ta"; Literal keeps the inclusive "chúng ta" of the Greek, and Balanced and Readable name the Father and the Son with the capitalised nouns.

decisions.choice: Lạy Cha thánh
decisions.reason: "Lạy" is the vocative of prayer, used as in 17:1 and through the chapter.

decisions.choice: 우리 for "we" (the Father and the Son), with no deity_pronoun span
alternatives: a capitalised pronoun as in the English
decisions.reason: Korean has no capitals; 우리 is the only word, and the honorific elsewhere in the prayer carries the respect.

source.text: ὅτε ἤμην μετ’ αὐτῶν ἐγὼ ἐτήρουν αὐτοὺς ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί σου ᾧ δέδωκάς μοι, καὶ ἐφύλαξα, καὶ οὐδεὶς ἐξ αὐτῶν ἀπώλετο εἰ μὴ ὁ υἱὸς τῆς ἀπωλείας, ἵνα ἡ γραφὴ πληρωθῇ.

records.literal_gloss: When I was with them, I was keeping them in the name of you which you have given me, and I guarded, and none of them perished except the son of the destruction, so that the Scripture might be fulfilled.

en.L: When I was with them, I was keeping them in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name, which {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have given {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, and I guarded [them], and not one of them perished except the son of perishing, so that the Scripture might be fulfilled.
en.B: While I was with them, I kept them in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name, the name {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have given {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. I guarded them, and not one of them was lost except the one doomed to be lost, so that the Scripture would be fulfilled.
en.R: While I was with them, I kept them safe by the power of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name, the name {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} gave {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. I guarded them, and not one of them was lost except the one who was doomed to be lost. This happened so that what the Scripture says would come true.

fr.L: Quand j’étais avec eux, {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, je les gardais en {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom, que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}as donné, et je [les] ai protégés, et aucun d’eux ne s’est perdu, sinon le fils de la perdition, afin que l’Écriture soit accomplie.
fr.B: Tant que j’étais avec eux, je les ai gardés en {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom, le nom que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}as donné. J’ai veillé sur eux, et aucun d’eux ne s’est perdu, sauf celui qui était voué à la perte, pour que l’Écriture s’accomplisse.
fr.R: Pendant que j’étais avec eux, je les ai protégés par la puissance de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom, le nom que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}as donné. J’ai veillé sur eux, et aucun d’eux ne s’est perdu, sauf celui qui devait se perdre. C’est arrivé pour que ce que dit l’Écriture se réalise.

sw.L: Nilipokuwa pamoja nao, {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} nilikuwa nikiwatunza katika jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} ambalo umenipa, nikawalinda, wala hakuna hata mmoja wao aliyeangamia isipokuwa mwana wa kuangamia, ili Maandiko yatimie.
sw.B: Nilipokuwa pamoja nao, niliwatunza katika jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}, lile jina ambalo umenipa. Niliwalinda, na hakuna hata mmoja wao aliyepotea, isipokuwa yule aliyekusudiwa kupotea, ili Maandiko yatimie.
sw.R: Nilipokuwa pamoja nao, niliwalinda salama kwa nguvu ya jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}, lile jina ulilonipa. Niliwachunga, na hakuna hata mmoja wao aliyepotea, isipokuwa yule aliyekusudiwa kupotea. Hili lilitokea ili yale Maandiko yasemayo yatimie.

vi.L: Khi Con còn ở với họ, Con đã gìn giữ họ trong danh Cha, [danh] mà Cha đã ban cho Con, và Con đã canh giữ [họ], và không ai trong họ bị hư mất, ngoại trừ con của sự hư mất, để Kinh Thánh được ứng nghiệm.
vi.B: Khi còn ở với họ, Con đã gìn giữ họ trong danh Cha, là danh Cha đã ban cho Con. Con đã canh giữ họ, và không một ai trong họ bị hư mất, trừ ra kẻ đã định phải hư mất, để lời Kinh Thánh được ứng nghiệm.
vi.R: Khi còn ở với họ, Con đã dùng quyền năng của danh Cha, là danh Cha đã ban cho Con, mà gìn giữ họ. Con đã canh giữ họ, và không một ai trong họ bị mất, trừ ra kẻ phải bị hư mất. Điều này xảy ra để lời Kinh Thánh trở thành sự thật.

ko.L: 제가 그들과 함께 있을 때에, 저는 아버지께서 저에게 주신 아버지의 이름 안에서 그들을 지키고 있었고, [그들을] 보호하였습니다. 그래서 그들 가운데 멸망의 아들 외에는 아무도 멸망하지 않았습니다. 이는 성경이 이루어지게 하려는 것이었습니다.
ko.B: 제가 그들과 함께 있는 동안, 아버지께서 저에게 주신 그 이름으로 그들을 지켰습니다. 제가 그들을 보호하였으므로, 그들 가운데 멸망하기로 정해진 사람 하나 말고는 아무도 멸망하지 않았습니다. 이는 성경 말씀이 이루어지게 하려는 것이었습니다.
ko.R: 제가 그들과 함께 있는 동안에는 아버지께서 주신 그 이름의 능력으로 그들을 지켰습니다. 제가 그들을 보호해서 한 사람도 잃지 않았습니다. 다만 멸망하기로 되어 있던 한 사람만 잃었습니다. 이것은 성경에 기록된 말씀이 이루어지게 하려는 것이었습니다.

decisions.choice: the son of destruction: the one marked out for destruction, the one doomed to be lost; Judas
decisions.reason: "Son of" with a noun is a Hebrew way of saying what a person belongs to or is headed for (compare "sons of disobedience", Ephesians 2:2). The noun ἀπωλείας comes from the same root as the verb ἀπώλετο just before it, "perished" or "was lost": none was lost except the one belonging to lostness. The words name Judas, whom Jesus already knew would hand him over (6:70-71; 13:18, 21-27). The same title is used for the man of lawlessness in 2 Thessalonians 2:3.

decisions.choice: the Scripture: most likely Psalm 41:10, already quoted of Judas in 13:18
alternatives: Psalm 109:8, applied to Judas in Acts 1:20
Scripture in general, without one verse in view
decisions.reason: John does not say which passage he means. In 13:18 Jesus quoted Psalm 41 ("the one who eats my bread has lifted his heel against me") of Judas, and said it was spoken "so that the Scripture may be fulfilled", the same phrase as here. Acts 1:20 applies Psalm 69 and Psalm 109 to Judas. Since only the general phrase is given, the reference is uncertain.

decisions.choice: Judas's loss was not a failure of Jesus's keeping: the Scripture had foretold it
decisions.reason: The imperfect ἐτήρουν ("I was keeping") describes Jesus's steady care through his ministry, and the aorist ἐφύλαξα ("I guarded") sums it up. Jesus said he would lose none of those the Father gave him (6:39; 10:28), and he repeats it in 18:9. Judas is named as the exception, but not as one the Father had given and the Son failed to keep: his path was foretold in Scripture, and he chose it (13:2, 27).

decisions.choice: in your name, which you have given me: as in 17:11, the name is what was given
alternatives: those whom you have given me I guarded
decisions.reason: As in 17:11, the SBLGNT reads ᾧ, referring to the name. Many later manuscripts read οὓς here and join it to the next verb: "I kept them in your name; those whom you gave me I guarded." The early manuscripts support the reading followed here. A reviewer should check this against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: perished ... the son of perishing (L); was lost ... the one doomed to be lost (B, R)
alternatives: was lost ... the son of destruction
decisions.reason: Every level keeps the wordplay between the verb and the noun (meaning decision m1). Literal uses "perish" for both, as it does for the same verb in 3:16 and 10:28, and keeps the Hebrew shape "son of". Balanced and Readable explain the idiom and use "lost", which suits the picture of a shepherd guarding his sheep (10:28; 18:9). "Son of perdition" is the familiar older wording.

decisions.choice: ne s’est perdu ... le fils de la perdition (L); ... celui qui était voué à la perte (B); ... celui qui devait se perdre (R)
alternatives: n’a péri ... le fils de perdition
decisions.reason: The Greek plays on one root ("perished ... the son of perishing"). French "se perdre" and "la perdition", "la perte" keep the echo at every level; Balanced and Readable say plainly what the Semitic idiom means, the one doomed to be lost (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: aliyeangamia ... mwana wa kuangamia (L); aliyepotea ... aliyekusudiwa kupotea (B, R)
decisions.reason: Every level keeps the play between the verb and the noun (meaning note m1). Literal uses "kuangamia" (perish), the verb of 3:16 and 10:28, and keeps the Hebrew shape "son of"; Balanced and Readable explain the idiom with "kupotea" (be lost). Readable says "niliwachunga" (I watched over them as a shepherd) for the second verb of guarding. "Maandiko" as at 13:18.

decisions.choice: bị hư mất ... con của sự hư mất (L); kẻ đã định phải hư mất (B); kẻ phải bị hư mất (R)
alternatives: đứa con của sự hủy diệt
decisions.reason: "Hư mất" (be lost, perish) is used for both the verb and the noun, so the wordplay of the Greek stays visible in Vietnamese. "Kẻ" marks Judas as the one who turned against Jesus.

decisions.choice: 멸망하다 ... 멸망의 아들 (L); 멸망하다 ... 멸망하기로 정해진 사람 (B); 잃다 ... 멸망하기로 되어 있던 사람 (R)
decisions.reason: Using 멸망 for both the verb and the noun keeps the Greek wordplay at Literal and Balanced; Readable says plainly that one was lost.

source.text: νῦν δὲ πρὸς σὲ ἔρχομαι, καὶ ταῦτα λαλῶ ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ ἵνα ἔχωσιν τὴν χαρὰν τὴν ἐμὴν πεπληρωμένην ἐν ἑαυτοῖς.

records.literal_gloss: But now to you I am coming, and these things I speak in the world so that they may have the joy the mine having been made full in themselves.

en.L: But now I am coming to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, and these things I speak in the world so that they may have the joy that is {{deity_pronoun:mine|Mine}} made full in themselves.
en.B: But now I am coming to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, and I speak these words while still in the world, so that within themselves they may have {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} joy complete.
en.R: Now I am coming to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. I am saying all this while I am still in the world, so that they will be full of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} joy.

fr.L: Mais maintenant je viens vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, et je dis ces choses dans le monde afin qu’ils aient la joie qui est la {{deity_pronoun:mienne|Mienne}}, rendue pleine en eux-mêmes.
fr.B: Mais maintenant je viens à {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, et je dis ces paroles pendant que je suis encore dans le monde, pour qu’ils aient en eux {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} joie, une joie complète.
fr.R: Maintenant, je viens auprès de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. Je dis tout cela pendant que je suis encore dans le monde, pour qu’ils soient remplis de {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} joie.

sw.L: Lakini sasa ninakuja {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}}, na mambo haya ninayasema ulimwenguni ili wawe na furaha iliyo {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} ikiwa imejazwa kikamilifu ndani yao wenyewe.
sw.B: Lakini sasa ninakuja {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}}, na ninasema maneno haya nikiwa bado ulimwenguni, ili ndani yao wenyewe wawe na furaha {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} iliyo kamili.
sw.R: Sasa ninakuja {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}}. Ninasema haya yote nikiwa bado ulimwenguni, ili furaha {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} ijae ndani yao.

vi.L: Nhưng bây giờ Con đến cùng Cha, và Con nói những điều này trong thế gian để họ có niềm vui của Con được đầy trọn trong chính họ.
vi.B: Nhưng bây giờ Con đến cùng Cha, và Con nói những lời này khi còn ở trong thế gian, để niềm vui của Con được trọn vẹn trong lòng họ.
vi.R: Giờ đây Con đang về với Cha. Con nói những điều này khi còn ở trong thế gian, để lòng họ tràn đầy niềm vui của Con.

ko.L: 그러나 이제 저는 아버지께로 갑니다. 그리고 제가 세상에서 이것들을 말하는 것은, 그들이 제 기쁨을 그들 안에 가득히 가지게 하려는 것입니다.
ko.B: 이제 저는 아버지께로 갑니다. 제가 아직 세상에 있으면서 이것을 말하는 것은, 그들이 제 기쁨을 그들 안에 온전히 누리게 하려는 것입니다.
ko.R: 이제 저는 아버지께로 갑니다. 제가 아직 세상에 있는 동안 이 모든 것을 말하는 것은, 그들이 제 기쁨으로 가득 차게 하려는 것입니다.

decisions.choice: these things I speak in the world: Jesus prays aloud, in the disciples' hearing, while he is still in the world
decisions.reason: "These things" are the words of this prayer, and perhaps the whole farewell discourse. Jesus speaks them where the disciples can hear (compare 11:42, where he prays aloud for the sake of the crowd), so that they will know what he has asked for them. "In the world" stands against "I am coming to you": he is still here, but not for long (17:11).

decisions.choice: my joy made full in them: the joy Jesus has in his union with the Father, given to the disciples and completed in them
decisions.reason: This is the promise of 15:11 and 16:20-24 again. The joy is Jesus's own, the joy of the Son who obeys and is loved by the Father (15:10-11). The perfect participle πεπληρωμένην ("having been made full") describes a joy filled and staying full, as in 16:24.

decisions.choice: made full (L); complete (B); full (R); while still (B), while I am still (R)
decisions.reason: The same wording as 15:11 and 16:24 at each level, since this is the same promise. "Joy" is the key term at every level. Balanced and Readable add "while still" to bring out the contrast with "I am coming to you" (meaning decision m1).

source.text: ἐγὼ δέδωκα αὐτοῖς τὸν λόγον σου, καὶ ὁ κόσμος ἐμίσησεν αὐτούς, ὅτι οὐκ εἰσὶν ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου καθὼς ἐγὼ οὐκ εἰμὶ ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου.

records.literal_gloss: I have given them the word of you, and the world hated them, because not they are of the world just as I not am of the world.

en.L: I have given them {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} word, and the world hated them, because they are not of the world, just as I am not of the world.
en.B: I have given {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} word to them, and the world has hated them, because they do not belong to the world, just as I do not belong to the world.
en.R: I have given {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} word to them, and the world has come to hate them. That is because they do not belong to the world, just as I do not belong to the world.

fr.L: Moi, je leur ai donné {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} parole, et le monde les a pris en haine, parce qu’ils ne sont pas issus du monde, de même que {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, je ne suis pas issu du monde.
fr.B: Je leur ai transmis {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} parole, et le monde les a haïs, parce qu’ils n’appartiennent pas au monde, tout comme je n’appartiens pas au monde.
fr.R: Je leur ai donné {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} parole, et le monde s’est mis à les détester. C’est parce qu’ils n’appartiennent pas au monde, de même que {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, je n’appartiens pas au monde.

sw.L: Mimi nimewapa neno {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}, na ulimwengu uliwachukia, kwa sababu wao si wa ulimwengu, kama vile {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} nisivyo wa ulimwengu.
sw.B: Nimewapa neno {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}, na ulimwengu umewachukia, kwa sababu wao si wa ulimwengu, kama vile {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} nisivyo wa ulimwengu.

vi.L: Con đã ban cho họ lời Cha, và thế gian đã ghét họ, vì họ không thuộc về thế gian, cũng như Con không thuộc về thế gian.
vi.B: Con đã truyền lời Cha cho họ, và thế gian đã ghét họ, vì họ không thuộc về thế gian, cũng như Con không thuộc về thế gian.
vi.R: Con đã trao lời Cha cho họ, và thế gian đã ghét họ. Đó là vì họ không thuộc về thế gian, cũng như Con không thuộc về thế gian.

ko.L: 저는 그들에게 아버지의 말씀을 주었습니다. 그리고 세상은 그들을 미워하였습니다. 제가 세상에 속하지 않은 것처럼, 그들도 세상에 속하지 않기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 제가 아버지의 말씀을 그들에게 주었더니, 세상은 그들을 미워하였습니다. 제가 세상에 속하지 않은 것처럼 그들도 세상에 속하지 않기 때문입니다.
ko.R: 저는 아버지의 말씀을 그들에게 주었습니다. 그러자 세상이 그들을 미워하게 되었습니다. 그것은 제가 세상에 속하지 않은 것처럼, 그들도 세상에 속하지 않기 때문입니다.

decisions.choice: your word: the Father's message as a whole, which Jesus has passed on to the disciples
decisions.reason: Jesus speaks only what the Father gave him (12:49-50; 17:8, "the words you gave me"). The disciples have kept that word (17:6), and it is this word that sets them apart from the world (17:17).

decisions.choice: the world hated them: the world's hatred is already a fact
decisions.reason: The verb ἐμίσησεν is aorist, stating it as something that has happened. Jesus has already warned them of it (15:18-21; 16:2-3), and the hatred that is about to fall on him includes them. The world here is humanity organized against God (15:18).

decisions.choice: not of the world: not belonging to the world, not having their origin and character from it
decisions.reason: "Of" means origin and belonging, as in 15:19 and 8:23 ("you are of this world; I am not of this world"). The disciples still live in the world (17:11, 15), but they take their life from the Father, as Jesus does.

decisions.choice: do not belong to the world (B, R); has hated / has come to hate (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Belong to" says plainly what "of" means here (meaning decision m3), as 15:19 does. The English perfect "has hated" fits a hatred that has begun and goes on (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: ne sont pas issus du monde (L); n’appartiennent pas au monde (B, R), here and in verse 16
decisions.reason: "Être du monde" is possible French but vague. The phrase means not having one's origin and character from the world (meaning decision m3): Literal says "issus de", which keeps the preposition of origin, and Balanced and Readable say "appartenir à", as the English does.

decisions.choice: 세상에 속하다 for "of the world" at every level
decisions.reason: 속하다 (belong to) is the clearest Korean for origin and allegiance together; Literal keeps it too, since a word-for-word "from the world" would read as leaving a place.

source.text: οὐκ ἐρωτῶ ἵνα ἄρῃς αὐτοὺς ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου ἀλλ’ ἵνα τηρήσῃς αὐτοὺς ἐκ τοῦ πονηροῦ.

records.literal_gloss: Not I ask that you take them out of the world but that you keep them from the evil [one].

en.L: I do not ask that {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} take them out of the world, but that {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} keep them from the evil [one].
en.B: I am not asking {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} to take them out of the world, but to keep them safe from the evil one.
en.R: I am not asking {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} to take them out of the world. I am asking {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} to keep them safe from the evil one.

fr.L: Je ne demande pas que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} les enlèves du monde, mais que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} les gardes du Mauvais.
fr.B: Je ne {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} demande pas de les retirer du monde, mais de les protéger du Mauvais.
fr.R: Je ne {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} demande pas de les retirer du monde. Je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} demande de les protéger du diable.

sw.L: Siombi kwamba uwaondoe ulimwenguni, bali kwamba uwatunze mbali na yule mwovu.
sw.B: Sikuombi uwaondoe ulimwenguni, bali uwalinde salama mbali na yule mwovu.
sw.R: Sikuombi uwaondoe ulimwenguni. Ninakuomba uwalinde salama mbali na yule mwovu.

vi.L: Con không xin Cha cất họ khỏi thế gian, nhưng xin Cha gìn giữ họ khỏi [kẻ] ác.
vi.B: Con không xin Cha đem họ ra khỏi thế gian, nhưng xin Cha gìn giữ họ khỏi kẻ ác.
vi.R: Con không xin Cha đem họ ra khỏi thế gian. Con xin Cha giữ họ an toàn khỏi kẻ ác.

ko.L: 제가 청하는 것은 아버지께서 그들을 세상에서 데려가시는 것이 아니라, 악한 [자]에게서 그들을 지키시는 것입니다.
ko.B: 제가 청하는 것은 그들을 세상에서 데려가 주시라는 것이 아니라, 악한 자에게서 그들을 지켜 주시라는 것입니다.
ko.R: 그들을 세상에서 데려가 주시기를 구하는 것이 아닙니다. 악한 자에게서 그들을 지켜 주시기를 구합니다.

decisions.choice: the evil one: the devil
decisions.reason: The form πονηροῦ can be masculine ("the evil one") or neuter ("evil"). John's writings use "the evil one" for the devil (1 John 2:13-14; 3:12; 5:18-19, "the evil one does not touch him ... the whole world lies in the evil one"), and Jesus has spoken of "the ruler of the world" (12:31; 14:30; 16:11). The same question arises in Matthew 6:13. A general prayer for protection from evil is also possible, so the choice is not certain.

decisions.choice: not taken out of the world, but kept from the evil one: the disciples stay in the world but are guarded out of the evil one's reach
decisions.reason: Jesus does not ask for escape. The disciples are sent into the world (17:18) and must stay there. The verb τηρήσῃς ("keep") is the one used in 17:11-12: the Father is to go on doing what Jesus did while he was with them.

decisions.choice: keep them safe from (B, R); the evil [one] (L)
decisions.reason: "Keep ... safe" makes clear that keeping here means protecting, as in 17:11-12. Literal brackets "one", which Greek leaves understood with the adjective.

decisions.choice: le Mauvais (L, B); le diable (R)
decisions.reason: Meaning decision m1 takes the word as "the evil one", the devil. French "le Mauvais" names a person with no supplied word, where English needs "[one]"; "le mal" would make it a thing, and "le Malin" is older church language. Readable names him plainly.

decisions.choice: yule mwovu, with no bracket
decisions.reason: "Mwovu" is a noun of the person class, "the evil one", the devil (meaning note m1), so Literal needs no bracketed word where the English brackets "[one]". Literal keeps "uwatunze" as in verses 11-12; Balanced and Readable say "keep safe".

source.text: ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου οὐκ εἰσὶν καθὼς ἐγὼ οὐκ εἰμὶ ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου.

records.literal_gloss: Of the world not they are just as I not am of the world.

en.L: Of the world they are not, just as I am not of the world.
en.B: They do not belong to the world, just as I do not belong to the world.
en.R: They do not belong to the world, just as I do not.

fr.L: Issus du monde, ils ne le sont pas, de même que {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, je ne suis pas issu du monde.
fr.B: Ils n’appartiennent pas au monde, tout comme je n’appartiens pas au monde.
fr.R: Ils n’appartiennent pas au monde, de même que {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, je n’y appartiens pas.

vi.L: Họ không thuộc về thế gian, cũng như Con không thuộc về thế gian.
vi.B: Họ không thuộc về thế gian, cũng như Con không thuộc về thế gian.
vi.R: Họ không thuộc về thế gian, cũng như Con vậy.

ko.L: 그들은 세상에 속하지 않습니다. 제가 세상에 속하지 않은 것과 같습니다.
ko.B: 제가 세상에 속하지 않은 것처럼, 그들도 세상에 속하지 않습니다.
ko.R: 그들은 세상에 속하지 않습니다. 저도 그렇습니다.

decisions.choice: they are not of the world: a repetition of 17:14 that stresses the point and leads into the request of 17:17
decisions.reason: The sentence repeats 17:14 almost word for word, but now "of the world" comes first, giving it weight. The world's hatred has been mentioned; now Jesus restates why it happens, and why the disciples need to be set apart by the truth (17:17).

decisions.choice: of the world: belonging to the world and taking one's life from it
decisions.reason: As in 17:14 and 15:19, "of" means origin and belonging (8:23).

decisions.choice: Of the world they are not (L)
alternatives: They are not of the world (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek order, which puts "of the world" first for emphasis (meaning decision m1). Balanced and Readable use the same wording as 17:14.

decisions.choice: Họ không thuộc về thế gian (normal order)
alternatives: Thuộc về thế gian thì họ không
decisions.reason: Vietnamese cannot front "of the world" as the Greek does without sounding contrived, so Literal keeps the normal order, like Balanced.

source.text: ἁγίασον αὐτοὺς ἐν τῇ ἀληθείᾳ· ὁ λόγος ὁ σὸς ἀλήθειά ἐστιν.

records.literal_gloss: Sanctify them in the truth; the word the yours truth is.

en.L: Sanctify them in the truth; {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} word is truth.
en.B: Set them apart for {{deity_pronoun:yourself|Yourself}} by the truth; {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} word is truth.
en.R: Set them apart for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} and make them holy by the truth. Your word is truth.

fr.L: Sanctifie-les dans la vérité ; {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} parole est vérité.
fr.B: Consacre-les à {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} par la vérité ; {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} parole est vérité.
fr.R: Mets-les à part pour {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} et rends-les saints par la vérité. Ta parole est la vérité.

sw.L: Uwatakase katika kweli; neno {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} ni kweli.
sw.B: Uwaweke wakfu kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} kwa njia ya kweli; neno {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} ni kweli.
sw.R: Uwatenge kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} na kuwafanya watakatifu kwa njia ya kweli. Neno {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} ni kweli.

vi.L: Xin thánh hóa họ trong chân lý; lời Cha là chân lý.
vi.B: Xin Cha biệt riêng họ ra cho Cha bởi chân lý; lời Cha là chân lý.
vi.R: Xin Cha dùng chân lý mà biệt riêng họ ra cho Cha và làm cho họ nên thánh. Lời Cha là chân lý.

ko.L: 진리 안에서 그들을 거룩하게 하십시오. 아버지의 말씀은 진리입니다.
ko.B: 진리로 그들을 거룩하게 구별하여 아버지께 속하게 해 주십시오. 아버지의 말씀은 진리입니다.
ko.R: 진리로 그들을 거룩하게 하셔서 아버지의 사람이 되게 해 주십시오. 아버지의 말씀은 진리입니다.

decisions.choice: sanctify: set them apart for God, make them holy and his own, for his service
decisions.reason: The verb ἁγίασον means to make holy, that is, to set apart as belonging to God. In the Old Testament it is used of priests consecrated for service (Exodus 28:41; 29:1) and of what is set apart for God (Exodus 13:2). John used it of Jesus himself, "whom the Father consecrated and sent into the world" (10:36). Moral purity follows from belonging to God, but the main idea is being his and set apart for his purpose, here the mission of 17:18. The verb shares its root with "Holy Father" (17:11).

decisions.choice: in the truth: by means of the truth, and so into the truth
alternatives: in the sphere of the truth only
decisions.reason: The preposition can mean "in" or "by". The next words, "your word is truth", explain it: the Father's word, which Jesus has given them (17:14), is what sets them apart. To be set apart by the truth is also to live in it.

decisions.choice: your word is truth: probably an echo of Psalm 119:142 ("your law is truth")
decisions.reason: The wording is close to Psalm 119:142 and 119:160 ("the sum of your word is truth"). In John the truth is God's reality made known, and Jesus himself is the truth (14:6). Whether the psalm is in view or the saying simply sums up the Father's word is uncertain.

decisions.choice: sanctify (L); set apart (B); set apart ... and make holy (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "sanctify", the traditional word, and uses it again in 17:19 so the link is plain. Balanced says "set apart", as in 10:36, and uses it again in 17:19. Readable uses "set apart" and adds "make holy" so that both sides of the word are clear (meaning decision m1). "Truth" is the key term at every level.

decisions.choice: for {{deity_pronoun:yourself|Yourself}} (B); for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say for whom they are set apart: for God, whose holiness they share (meaning decision m1). "Set apart" on its own could leave this unclear.

decisions.choice: sanctifier (L); consacrer à toi (B); mettre à part pour toi et rendre saints (R); the same verbs in verse 19
decisions.reason: The verb means setting apart for God, making holy and his own (meaning decision m1). "Sanctifier" is the traditional word and is kept at Literal; "consacrer" is the ordinary French word for dedicating someone to God; Readable spells out both sides, as the English does.

decisions.choice: kutakasa (L); kuweka wakfu (B); kutenga ... kuwafanya watakatifu (R)
decisions.reason: Each level uses its verb from 10:36, where the Father consecrated the Son, and the same verb again in verse 19, so the three uses stay linked (meaning notes m1, m2). "Kutakasa" can sound like cleansing only; Balanced says "set apart" for God, and Readable adds "make holy", as the English does. "Kweli" is the key term for truth.

decisions.choice: thánh hóa (L); biệt riêng ra cho Cha (B); biệt riêng ... và làm cho nên thánh (R)
decisions.reason: "Thánh hóa" is the theological word for "sanctify" and keeps its link to "Cha thánh" (17:11); Balanced and Readable say in plain words what it means, as the English does.

decisions.choice: 거룩하게 하다 (L); 거룩하게 구별하다 (B); 거룩하게 하여 아버지의 사람이 되게 하다 (R) for "sanctify"
decisions.reason: The verb means both to make holy and to set apart for God; Balanced joins the two, and Readable says whose they become. The same words return in verse 19.

source.text: καθὼς ἐμὲ ἀπέστειλας εἰς τὸν κόσμον, κἀγὼ ἀπέστειλα αὐτοὺς εἰς τὸν κόσμον·

en.R: You sent {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} into the world. In the same way, I have sent them into the world.

sw.R: Wewe ulinituma ulimwenguni. Kwa njia hiyo hiyo, nimewatuma wao ulimwenguni.

vi.L: Như Cha đã sai Con vào thế gian, Con cũng đã sai họ vào thế gian.
vi.B: Như Cha đã sai Con vào thế gian, thì Con cũng sai họ vào thế gian như vậy.
vi.R: Cha đã sai Con vào thế gian. Cũng vậy, Con đã sai họ vào thế gian.

ko.L: 아버지께서 저를 세상에 보내신 것처럼, 저도 그들을 세상에 보냈습니다.
ko.B: 아버지께서 저를 세상에 보내신 것과 같이, 저도 그들을 세상에 보냈습니다.
ko.R: 아버지께서 저를 세상에 보내셨습니다. 그와 같이 저도 그들을 세상에 보냈습니다.

decisions.choice: the disciples' mission is patterned on Jesus's own: as the Father sent him, so he sends them
decisions.reason: Jesus is "the one sent" throughout John (3:17; 5:36; 17:3, 8). Now his disciples share his mission (13:20; 20:21, "as the Father has sent me, I also send you"). This is why Jesus does not ask that they be taken out of the world (17:15).

decisions.choice: I sent them: the sending is spoken of as already done
decisions.reason: The verb ἀπέστειλα is aorist. Jesus has already sent them out once (4:38, "I sent you to reap"), and their commission is complete in his mind, though it is given in full after the resurrection (20:21).

decisions.choice: I in the same way have sent (B); In the same way, I have sent (R)
decisions.reason: "In the same way" brings out the matching of the two sendings (meaning decision m1), and the English perfect suits a sending that stands (meaning decision m2).

source.text: καὶ ὑπὲρ αὐτῶν ἐγὼ ἁγιάζω ἐμαυτόν, ἵνα ὦσιν καὶ αὐτοὶ ἡγιασμένοι ἐν ἀληθείᾳ.

records.literal_gloss: And for them I sanctify myself, so that may be also they having been sanctified in truth.

en.L: And for their sake I sanctify {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}}, so that they also may be sanctified in truth.
en.B: For their sake I set {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}} apart, so that they too may be set apart by the truth.
en.R: For their sake I set {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}} apart for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, so that they too may be set apart and made holy by the truth.

fr.L: Et pour eux, je {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} sanctifie {{deity_pronoun:moi-même|Moi-même}}, afin qu’eux aussi soient sanctifiés dans [la] vérité.
fr.B: Pour eux, je {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} consacre {{deity_pronoun:moi-même|Moi-même}}, afin qu’eux aussi soient consacrés par la vérité.
fr.R: Pour eux, je {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} mets à part pour {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, afin qu’eux aussi soient mis à part et rendus saints par la vérité.

sw.L: Na kwa ajili yao {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} najitakasa {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}, ili nao pia wawe wenye kutakaswa katika kweli.
sw.B: Kwa ajili yao najiweka wakfu {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}, ili nao pia wawekwe wakfu kwa njia ya kweli.
sw.R: Kwa ajili yao najitenga {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, ili nao pia watengwe na kufanywa watakatifu kwa njia ya kweli.

vi.L: Và vì họ, Con thánh hóa chính mình, để họ cũng được thánh hóa trong chân lý.
vi.B: Vì họ, Con biệt riêng chính mình ra, để họ cũng được biệt riêng ra bởi chân lý.
vi.R: Vì họ, Con biệt riêng chính mình ra cho Cha, để họ cũng được biệt riêng ra và nên thánh bởi chân lý.

ko.L: 그리고 그들을 위하여 저는 저 자신을 거룩하게 합니다. 이는 그들도 진리 안에서 거룩하게 되게 하려는 것입니다.
ko.B: 그들을 위하여 저는 저 자신을 거룩하게 구별하여 드립니다. 그들도 진리로 거룩하게 구별되게 하려는 것입니다.
ko.R: 그들을 위해 저는 저 자신을 아버지께 온전히 바칩니다. 그것은 그들도 진리로 거룩하게 되어 아버지의 사람이 되게 하려는 것입니다.

decisions.choice: I sanctify myself: Jesus dedicates himself to God for his death, offered on their behalf
alternatives: Jesus dedicates himself to his mission in general
decisions.reason: The verb ἁγιάζω is the one used for setting apart priests and sacrifices for God (Exodus 28:41; Deuteronomy 15:19). "For their sake" uses ὑπὲρ, the preposition John uses for Jesus's death on behalf of others (10:11, 15; 11:50-52; 15:13). Spoken on the night before the cross, the words most likely mean that he gives himself to God as an offering. They could also mean his dedication to the whole work the Father gave him (10:36; 17:4); the text does not say more.

decisions.choice: so that they may be sanctified in truth: their being set apart depends on his, and lasts
decisions.reason: The perfect participle ἡγιασμένοι ("having been sanctified") describes a lasting state. The disciples are set apart because Jesus has set himself apart for them: what he asked the Father to do in 17:17 rests on what he does here. The same verb, used three times in 17:17-19, links his self-giving and their consecration.

decisions.choice: in truth: in the truth of 17:17, not merely "truly"
decisions.reason: Here "truth" has no article, and the phrase could mean "truly", as it sometimes does. Coming just after "sanctify them in the truth; your word is truth" (17:17), it most likely picks up the same truth. Either way the sense is close.

decisions.choice: sanctify ... sanctified (L); set apart ... set apart (B, R); for you, made holy (R)
decisions.reason: Each level uses the same verb as it did in 17:17, so that the link between Jesus's self-giving and the disciples' consecration is visible (meaning decision m2). Balanced and Readable say "by the truth" as in 17:17 (meaning decision m3). Readable adds "for you" and "made holy", as in 17:17. "Truth" is the key term at every level.

decisions.choice: dans [la] vérité
decisions.reason: The Greek has no article, but "en vérité" in French means "truly", the sense meaning decision m3 sets aside; Literal supplies the article in brackets so that it reads as the truth of verse 17.
